subject: Strea
text: Strea agrees to accompany you when asked, after repeated conversations raise the bond.

evidence.quote: Raising the bond with Strea is quite tiresome initially (best way I found was to just talk to her again, and again, and again...), but eventually she will agree to accompany you when asked.

subject: Strea
text: Finishing floor 94 is the point of no return for the Strea bond achievement, so the bond must be raised beforehand.

evidence.quote: The point of no return for this one is finishing floor 94, so you'll want to grab it beforehand.

subject: Strea
text: Buying a large number of snacks raises Strea's bond quickly.

evidence.quote: Then you can go crazy and just buy a ton of snacks to raise her bond quickly, just like with the other characters.

subject: defeating the 82nd floor boss
text: After the 82nd floor boss is killed, Strea can be talked to in the city at Agil's inn.

evidence.quote: After you kill the 82th boss floor, she will be avaible in the city to talk, in the agil's inn.

subject: Strea
object: taking a stroll and buying food
text: Inviting Strea on a stroll, buying her food, and talking to her raise the friendship.

evidence.quote: Then just invite her to take a stroll and buy food/talk to her to level up the friendship

subject: Goblin King
text: The Goblin King is on the top floor of the Floor 82 dungeon arena.

evidence.quote: go to the Floor 82 dungeon arena, head to the top floor to kill the Goblin King.

subject: Goblin King
text: Sleeping at the inn is used to reset and repeat the Goblin King fight.

evidence.quote: [janisckinho] go to the Floor 82 dungeon arena, head to the top floor to kill the Goblin King. Sleep at the inn, then repeat the process until the item drops

subject: Goblin King
text: The Goblin King must be killed repeatedly until the item drops.

evidence.quote: repeat the process until the item drops
